10683: //    struct LL { next: Option<Box<LL>> }

10685: // However, there were a couple of problems:

10746:     pub closed spec fn next_ptr(&self, i: nat) -> *mut Node {
10747:         if i == 0 {
10748:             core::ptr::null_mut()
10749:         } else {
10750:             self.perms@.index((i - 1) as nat).0.ptr()

10754:     pub closed spec fn valid_node(&self, i: nat, next_ptr: *mut Node) -> bool {
10755:         0 <= i < self.data@.len ==> (
10756:             self.perms@.dom().contains(i) && {
10757:                   let (perm, padding, block_token, is_exposed) = self.perms@.index(i);
10758: 
10759:                   // Each node points to the next node
10760:                   perm.is_init()
10761:                   && perm.value().ptr.addr() == next_ptr.addr()
10762: 
10763:                   // The PointsToRaw makes up the rest of the block size allocation
10764:                   && block_token.key().block_size - size_of::<Node>() >= 0
10765:                   && padding.is_range(perm.ptr().addr() + size_of::<Node>(),
10766:                       block_token.key().block_size - size_of::<Node>())
10767:                   && padding.provenance() == perm.ptr()@.provenance
10768:                   && is_exposed.provenance() == padding.provenance()
10769: 
10770:                   // block_token is correct
10771:                   && block_token.instance_id() == self.data@.instance.id()
10772:                   && is_block_ptr(perm.ptr() as *mut u8, block_token.key())
10773: 
10774:                   && (self.data@.fixed_page ==> (
10775:                       block_token.key().page_id == self.data@.page_id
10776:                       && block_token.key().block_size == self.data@.block_size
10777:                       //&& padding.provenance() == self.data@.page_id.segment_id.provenance
10778:                   ))
10779: 
10780:                   && (match self.data@.heap_id {
10781:                       Some(heap_id) => block_token.value().heap_id == Some(heap_id),
10782:                       None => true,
10783:                   })
10784:             }
10785:         )
10786:     }
